items.html:
Trevor McMahon was wicketkeeper with no pretensions of being a batsman who made his debut on New Zealand's tour of India and Pakistan in 1956-57, playing in four Tests. Although he kept his place for the first home Test against West Indies later that season, his poor batting resulted in him being replaced.
Wisden Cricinfo staff
